children: Holtec Nuclear unveiled terms of a planned initial public offering that could give the nuclear technology company an initial market capitalization topping $10 billion.
Holtec on Tuesday said it plans to sell 50 million shares at between $15 and $18 apiece in the IPO.

At the $16.50 midpoint of that price range, the Camden, N.J., company said it expects net proceeds of about $775.2 million, or around $893.1 million if the underwriters exercise an option to buy an additional 7.5 million shares.

Holtec said it would have about 574.2 million shares outstanding after the IPO, assuming an exercise of the overallotment option, for a market capitalization of more than $10.3 billion at the $18-a-share high end of the pricing range.
The company said it has applied to list its shares on the Nasdaq Stock Market under the symbol HNUC.
